section_1.title: Your living costs, paid into your bank.
section_1.description: Support for rent, travel, food, and books. Paid directly to you in three instalments (usually at the start of each term).

section_2.title: How Maintenance Loans are assessed
section_2.description: Assessed by Student Finance England based on location, household income, and course intensity.

cards.title: Household Income
cards.description: The amount depends on your household income (partner's income if living together, or parents' income if dependent).

cards.title: Where you live
cards.description: Higher maximum amounts are available to students studying in London or living away from their parents.

cards.title: Paid termly
cards.description: The loan is released in three instalments (33%, 33%, 34%) after the university confirms your enrolment.

faqs.q: Do I have to pay it back?
faqs.a: Yes, it is combined with your tuition fee loan balance, and repaid together once you graduate and earn above the Plan 5 threshold.

faqs.q: What if my household income is high?
faqs.a: You will still be eligible for the non-income-assessed minimum portion of the maintenance loan, regardless of income.
